As your step GUIDE, the interface guides you through each menu, suggesting experienced starting settings for APC applications. • All APC modes are integrated into the VIO®3 and VIO®3 n: pulsed APC®, forced APC and precise APC® • The APC socket – your connection for APC filtered instruments • Besides the APC socket, an additional multifunctional socket is provided for further instruments.
